rows.name: Manufacture of fabricated metal products, except machinery and equipment

sources.research: Metal fabrication job shops: quoting from drawings by hand, many small owner-run firms, Italy specialised (LQ 1.39); automatic quoting tools exist (Radquote, Almaquote, Quotify) (https://hexagon.com/it/products/radan-radquote https://www.itismagazine.it/tecnologie/quanto-costa-una-lavorazioni-cnc-te-lo-dice-quotify)

Installers (electrical, plumbing, HVAC, solar): paper job reports, quotes, scheduling, bonus paperwork; ready field-service tools exist; reachable via CNA, Confartigianato, Assistal; same top rank in DE; artisans shrinking (https://www.teamsystem.com/magazine/construction/gestione-digitale-rapporti-intervento/ https://www.italiaoggi.it/diritto-e-fisco/lavoro-e-previdenza/trovare-un-idraulico-o-un-elettricista-sara-sempre-piu-difficile-crollano-gli-artigiani-in-italia-a130ja46)
